title: SEBI Final Order: Front Running by Madhav Stock Vision Pvt. Ltd. and Others
description: SEBI's final order against Madhav Stock Vision Pvt. Ltd. and five individuals for front running trades of a Big Client (Life Insurance Corporation of India) between April 2020 and December 2023, using non-public information obtained from dealers at empanelled brokers.

title: SEBI Penalises Pace Stock Broking Services for Front Running Axis Mutual Fund Trades
description: SEBI adjudication order finds Pace Stock Broking Services Private Limited violated Stock Brokers Regulations by failing to preserve IP address records and enabling front-running of Axis Mutual Fund trades by certain clients.

title: Notice of Attachment dated July 22, 2026 issued under RC No. 9182 of 2026 against Ankit Ajitbhai Panchal in DU Digital Technologies Trading Matter
description: SEBI's Recovery Officer issued a Notice of Attachment under RC No. 9182 of 2026 against Ankit Ajitbhai Panchal to recover outstanding dues arising from proceedings related to trading activities of certain entities in the scrip of DU Digital Technologies Limited (now DU Digital Global Limited).

title: SEBI Order Releasing Salary Account of Gauranga Roy in Recovery Proceedings RC3547 of 2021 Against Vasundhara Realcon Ltd.
description: SEBI's Recovery Officer has passed an order releasing the previously attached salary account of Gauranga Roy, held in connection with recovery certificate RC3547 of 2021 issued against Vasundhara Realcon Ltd.

title: SEBI Recovery Notice of Demand Against Jigar Bhailalbhai Khalash for Trading in ANI Integrated Services Limited
description: SEBI issued a recovery notice of demand for Rs. 2,13,000 against Jigar Bhailalbhai Khalash under Certificate No. 9226 of 2026, following an unpaid penalty imposed for trading activity in the scrip of ANI Integrated Services Limited.

title: SEBI Notice of Demand Against Lataben Narotambhai Rangi for Penalty in ANI Integrated Services Trading Matter
description: SEBI issued a recovery notice of demand for Rs. 2,13,000 against Lataben Narotambhai Rangi under Certificate No. 9227 of 2026, pursuant to an adjudication penalty for trading activity in ANI Integrated Services Limited scrip.

title: SEBI General Remittance Order Against In House Productions Ltd. for Failure to Obtain SCORES Authentication
description: SEBI issued a General Remittance Order dated July 13, 2026 under RC No. 4833 of 2022, transferring recovery proceedings against In House Productions Ltd. for its failure to obtain SCORES authentication.

title: SEBI Order Against Zara Portal (Proprietor Mr. Anurag Jaiswal) for Unregistered Investment Advisory Activities
description: SEBI has passed an enforcement order against Zara Portal, proprietor Mr. Anurag Jaiswal, for receiving payments linked to unregistered investment advisory services allegedly provided under the guise of a SEBI-registered investment adviser, Sai Proficient Research Investment Advisory.

title: SEBI Orders Action Against Shree Sai Proficient Financial Services for Unregistered Investment Advisory Activities
description: SEBI issued a show cause notice and order against Shree Sai Proficient Financial Services (Proprietor Ms. Madhuri Garg) for providing unregistered investment advisory services and impersonating a SEBI-registered advisor to solicit assured-return payments from investors.

title: SEBI Cancels Recovery Certificate No. 5741 of 2022 Against Prabhaben Gordhandas Savjani in Excel Castronics Limited Matter
description: SEBI's Recovery Officer has issued an order cancelling Recovery Certificate No. 5741 of 2022, which was issued against Prabhaben Gordhandas Savjani in connection with recovery proceedings related to Excel Castronics Limited.

title: SEBI Release Order for Recovery Certificate No. 6273 of 2023 Against Kartik Clothing And Fabrics Pvt. Ltd. in the Matter of Excel Castronics Limited
description: SEBI's Recovery Officer has issued a release order discharging Recovery Certificate No. 6273 of 2023 issued against Kartik Clothing And Fabrics Pvt. Ltd. in connection with recovery proceedings in the matter of Excel Castronics Limited.

title: SEBI Order in Respect of Shri. Siddhant Suresh Chandan – Unregistered Investment Advisory Services
description: SEBI passes a fresh order against Shri. Siddhant Suresh Chandan following SAT's remand directing re-computation of the fee liable to be refunded for providing unregistered investment advisory services.

title: SEBI Order in the Matter of Utilis Fund
description: SEBI passes an order in the matter of Utilis Fund, addressing regulatory compliance and enforcement actions related to the fund's operations.

title: Order in the Matter of Argentum Dynamic Alternative Investment Fund
description: SEBI enforcement order against Argentum Dynamic Alternative Investment Fund for violations of SEBI (Alternative Investment Funds) Regulations, 2012, with directions and/or penalties issued by the adjudicating authority.

title: SEBI Order: Market Access Restrained for 17 Entities in Veerkrupa Jewellers Matter
description: SEBI has restrained 17 individuals and entities from accessing the securities market for 3 to 5 years in connection with M/s Veerkrupa Jewellers Limited, via order dated May 29, 2026.

title: SEBI Order Against Suzlon Energy Limited for Financial Misrepresentation and PFUTP/LODR Violations
description: SEBI issues enforcement order under Section 15-I(3) of the SEBI Act and Section 23-I(3) of the SCRA against Suzlon Energy Limited and four officials for alleged misrepresentation in financial statements and violations of PFUTP and LODR Regulations during FY 2014-15 to FY 2020-21.

title: SEBI Order Against Mr. Nishaan Singh (Sanbun Investments) for Unregistered Portfolio Management Services
description: SEBI passes fresh order against Mr. Nishaan Singh, Proprietor of Sanbun Investments, following SAT remand to reassess quantum of funds received for unregistered portfolio management services and determine refund and debarment period.

title: SEBI Order Against Ventureland Asia Advisors Services LLP
description: SEBI enforcement order against Ventureland Asia Advisors Services LLP for violations of securities laws and regulations governing investment advisory or portfolio management services.

title: Order in the Matter of IndoStar Credit Fund
description: SEBI enforcement order dated May 22, 2026 in the matter of IndoStar Credit Fund, addressing regulatory compliance issues related to the fund's operations.

title: SEBI Order in the Matter of Domus Capital LLP
description: SEBI enforcement order against Domus Capital LLP for violations of securities laws, directing specific penalties or remedial actions as determined by the adjudicating authority.

title: SEBI Order in the Matter of India Electronic Development Fund
description: SEBI enforcement order concerning the India Electronic Development Fund (IEDF), an SEBI-registered Alternative Investment Fund focused on the electronics and semiconductor sector.

title: SEBI Order in the Matter of Bajaj Hindusthan Sugar Limited - Fund Diversion and RPT Non-Disclosure
description: SEBI order pursuant to Bombay High Court directions concerning Bajaj Hindusthan Sugar Limited, its promoters Shishir Bajaj and Kushagra Bajaj, involving alleged diversion of over ₹1,189 crore and non-disclosure of related party transactions.

title: SEBI Order Against Future Retail Limited Directors for Fraud, Misleading Disclosures and Fund Diversion
description: SEBI passes a 222-page enforcement order against 11 noticees including Kishore Biyani and other top executives of Future Retail Limited for misleading disclosures, understatement of debt, non-disclosure of related party transactions, and diversion of company funds.

title: SEBI Order on Front Running by Prijesh Kurani and Others
description: SEBI issued an enforcement order against 7 noticees including Prijesh Kurani and associates for front running trades of big client Anustup Trading Private Limited during January 2022 to February 2023.

title: SEBI Order Against Unregistered Investment Advisors Running Telegram Channels Intraday Jackpot and Professional Day Trading Institute
description: SEBI issues enforcement order against Akshay Kumar and five others for operating unregistered investment advisory and research analyst services through Telegram channels, collecting fees and making fraudulent profit claims.

title: Final Order Against Arun Panchariya in GDR Issue by Winsome Yarns Ltd.
description: SEBI issues a final adjudication order against Arun Panchariya for his role in fraudulent Global Depository Receipt (GDR) transactions by Winsome Yarns Ltd., following remand by SAT to recompute the penalty quantum.

title: Order Against M/s AFCO Capital India Private Limited - Merchant Banker Restrictions
description: SEBI issues order against AFCO Capital India Private Limited (SEBI Reg. No. INM000012555) for violations of Merchant Bankers Regulations, Intermediaries Regulations, PFUTP and PIT Regulations following inspection for April 2022 to August 2024.

title: Order in the matter of Front-running trades of Big Client - Sarvottam Securities Private Limited by multiple entities
description: SEBI order against four individuals — Mr. Sunny Bhatia, Mrs. Surbhi Chopra Bhatia, Mrs. Mamta Rani, and Mr. Kumar Ashok — for front-running trades of Big Client Sarvottam Securities Pvt. Ltd. in equity derivatives during January 2018 to December 2022.

title: SEBI Order Against Retro Green Revolution Limited - Price Manipulation and Market Fraud
description: SEBI issues enforcement order against 21 noticees including promoters and associates of Retro Green Revolution Limited for price manipulation, volume creation, and fraudulent trading activities on BSE.

title: Order Against Cash Cow Broking & Advisory Solutions for Unregistered Investment Advisory Activities
description: SEBI passes directions against Cash Cow Broking & Advisory Solutions and its partners for conducting investment advisory services without registration, ordering refund of fees collected from investors.

title: SEBI Order Against Arcotech Limited: Fund Diversion and Financial Statement Misrepresentation
description: SEBI issues enforcement order against Arcotech Limited and 13 related entities for alleged fund diversion of Rs.14.15 crores, fictitious transactions, and misrepresentation of financial statements across FY 2016-17 to 2020-21.

title: SEBI Order Against Mediaone Global Entertainment Ltd. for Fund Diversion and Financial Manipulation
description: SEBI issues enforcement order against Mediaone Global Entertainment Ltd. and its directors for alleged fund diversion and financial irregularities linked to Eros International Media Limited, involving a write-off of ₹63.61 crore.

title: Order in the matter of trading activities of certain entities in the scrip of DU Digital Technologies Limited (now DU Digital Global Limited)
description: SEBI order against 27 entities for employing deceptive trading strategies and contributing to artificial price and volume manipulation in DU Digital scrip during August 26, 2021 to March 31, 2023.

title: SEBI Final Order against M/s. MAN Industries (India) Limited and Others
description: SEBI final order regarding financial misrepresentation, non-consolidation of subsidiaries, and related party transaction non-disclosures by MAN Industries (India) Limited.

title: Final Order in the matter of Seacoast Shipping Services Limited
description: SEBI issued a final order under sections 11 and 11B of the SEBI Act, 1992 regarding Seacoast Shipping Services Limited and associated noticees concerning misrepresentation of financial statements and other violations.

title: Women suffer collateral damage from the political battles of men—when will public discourse mature?
description: It's a tale as old as patriarchy—women being deployed as weapons in warfare among men. Think of successful professionals such as Giorgia Meloni and Trisha Krishnan. The agency of women and quality of discourse are the first casualties of toxic political sniping.

title: The rise in women at work in India is not a statistical illusion but a cause for optimism over income growth
description: India’s rising female labour force participation has left some observers who took a closer look unimpressed. What the data reveals, however, is an opportunity for India to accelerate a valuable source of income growth.

title: India's quest for sovereign AI is off to a splendid start: here’s how it can be achieved within a few years
description: America’s Mythos curbs were a sharp reminder of the risk of reliance on foreign AI models. India has already taken policy initiatives that can add up to self-reliance. What it takes are AI systems whose data resides at home and whose keys are held locally.

title: School children shouldn’t have to pay the price for untenable orthodoxies about learning
description: A no exams, no 'failing' policy for school children till age 15 may have seemed like a progressive idea, but how did it work out? While continuous evaluation was supposed to keep learning on track, a whole generation of students had to bear the cost.

title: Does anything justify the sky-high valuations of America’s Big AI firms? Here’s what might—or not
description: Scepticism over the huge valuations of Big AI players like Anthropic, OpenAI and Nvidia may have grown amid warnings from financial risk trackers, but a scenario exists to justify them. How dreamy it is remains unclear, though.

title: Mint Quick Edit | India Inc’s June quarter results sprang a pleasant surprise: will stocks rise too?
description: The first quarter of this fiscal year saw a wide sample of companies outperform expectations in defiance of a war shock. Are Indian equity indices finally about to snap a flat trend?

title: How big a worry is revolving credit offered by India’s shadow lenders? It can be sandbox-tested
description: Revolving credit is risky. It can lead debtors into debt traps, while juggled credit lines can create systemic stress. But India’s credit market needs rivalry and barring shadow banks from offering flexi loans may throw the baby out with the bathwater.

title: Why guardrails and constitutions aren't enough to stop rogue AI—and what may actually work instead
description: Despite elaborate efforts to ensure AI models only act in ways we approve of, every few days we hear of AI playing fast and loose with ethics. Perhaps we can take cues from human moral conditioning to stop AI agents from going rogue.

title: Democrat leaders who renounce their 'woke' past can’t get away with it—voters aren’t asleep
description: Comments from Democrats like Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez and Abdul El-Sayed suggest centrist shifts that risk letting progressive supporters down. ‘Play to the gallery, pivot to the centre’ is a formula that makes leaders look like followers of opinion polls.

title: Not all FDI is the same: The country must rejig what statistics capture to focus on the right kind
description: If India is to defend its currency sustainably, the country must attract and earn more dollars. Since what gets measured gets managed, we should reclassify FDI statistics to offer visibility on the capital inflows we most acutely need.

title: India’s privacy regime must find an optimal balance that survives without falling into extreme traps
description: There’s a way for the country to steer clear of both unchecked surveillance and administrative opacity, but it would require judicial refinement and delegated rules to balance utility, transparency and privacy rights.

title: AI jobocalypse: What can be done to address the defining business challenge of our time?
description: Fears of large-scale unemployment driven by artificial intelligence (AI) aren't unfounded. Although governments could consider tax nudges to level the playing field between bots and human workers, it is ultimately employers who must help their employees cope.

title: Why it's a good thing that RBI’s swap facility for overseas-Indian deposits is closing early
description: The scheme has been a success but it’s far from costless. In any case, Indian policy must focus on a lasting solution to the country’s current account deficit, which demands action on two other fronts. Treat the cause, not the symptom.

title: Mint Quick Edit | The US-Iran memo may be irrelevant but the future of this chokepoint is not
description: The truce fell apart weeks ago and the Strait of Hormuz is still held hostage by war, with both Iran and the US claiming control of it. As global oil stockpiles run down, this game of mutually assured obstruction must end.

title: AI adoption: Forward deployed engineers may have an understanding but what about judgement?
description: A clear grasp of what businesses need and what AI models can do is one thing, but getting it right is another. Stacking up competencies doesn’t always yield wisdom. AI adoption involves weighty decisions—and the skills needed to take them aren’t easily available.

title: Zero-sum game? Much of what made mathematics meaningful to those who study it is now being done by AI
description: Mathematicians may be in the throes of a 'spiritual crisis,’ like their peers in the fields of writing, creating art and analysing data. But whether AI aids or ruins the pursuit of mathematical truth depends on whether what we value undergoes a shift.

title: Brave new world: How an obsession with tech-enabled efficiency could turn us into zombies
description: Efficiency is not the be-all and end-all of every human endeavour, but technologists seem bent on taking it to an extreme. It may be a good idea to be a luddite if technology insists on stripping our choices away and pushing us to lead soulless lives.

title: Dovish views on inflation are abundant but the arguments being made are unconvincing
description: Those keen on an easy money policy argue that price instability isn’t a problem in India. While their reasons may sound coherent, the case they make for lower rates of interest usually falls flat. Here's why.

title: Honey, I shrunk the CEO tenure: Corporate boards should stop creating disposable chief executives
description: India Inc is replacing its top executives faster than ever, but the corner office must never have a revolving door. Instead, company boards should do some self-reflection in the context of corporate governance. Here are five practices that could help.

title: Sapta Dhaara: seven streams of high-priority policy attention for India to achieve Viksit Bharat by 2047
description: The Prime Minister’s emphasis on seven focal endeavours for developed-nation status by 2047 offers India a well streamlined set of national imperatives. Education would have to play the role of a talent tributary to each stream.

title: Mint Quick Edit | How America may be able to test a controversial theory about falling crime rates
description: Is tough policing behind a slide in US rates of violent crime? Did Steven Levitt and Stephen Dubner of ‘Freakonomics’ fame correctly spot a long-term role played by legalized abortion? The latter argument could be tested anew over the next two decades.

title: India at 80: Time to confront the issues it is facing
description: Three decades from now, India will have more older people than young. Are we ready to face that challenge? We’ll need to think about it today.

title: High time for India to conserve, promote talent
description: There are mainly two reasons for professionals leaving government institutions. The private sector pays two to five times more salary. In the government, regulations regarding retirement and other benefits remind you of the colonial times.

title: Oil and gas exploration policy: Why India should price risk, not subsidize it
description: India's latest attempt to incentivize hydrocarbon exploration has the right intent, but is covering up to half the cost of private efforts really the best option? Policymakers should think harder about what makes an upstream petroleum fiscal regime work.

title: Indonesia's central bank has a new acting governor—but will the government let her do her job?
description: How much operating space does the president's nominee to Indonesia’s central bank have? Signals of autonomy will support market confidence in policy. Jakarta mustn’t ignore the risk of capital flight if politics is seen to be in control.

title: Chandrasekaran's exit: the future of this storied conglomerate hinges on succession at Tata Sons
description: Why a successor was not identified for leadership of the Tata Group’s holding company is a good question. But this is a family-run group and it’s now for Noel Tata to decide who chairs Tata Sons. Everyone must respect that.

title: Barry Eichengreen: Okay, so America has escaped a recession—but only by the skin of its teeth
description: Various factors have helped America defy gloomy predictions so far, but that doesn’t mean the risk of shrunken output has receded. In fact, for those wondering what could go wrong, the answer is pretty much everything.

title: Who will run Bombay House next? Harsh Goenka has two names
description: Tata Sons’ next chairman will need more than a stellar corporate résumé. The choice will test Tata’s values, governance and ability to balance performance with institutional continuity.

title: Manu Joseph: Here’s a theory that could explain why good things happen in India
description: Indians spend much time wondering what is wrong with the country and analysing its disorder, but equally baffling is what makes things to go right. Sometimes, an oddball official springs up who has the nerve to shrug off convention and do what must be done.

title: Jatin Mehta: the quiet fugitive behind a billion-dollar vanishing act
description: Jatin Mehta built Winsome Diamonds into a market leader before quietly stepping down, fleeing India and leaving banks facing more than  ₹6,800 crore in liabilities.

title: Can AI make you a better thinker?
description: Whether your mental abilities weaken or strengthen is more up to you than you think.&nbsp;

title: MSME minister: How India’s amended law could create a more dynamic MSME sector for Viksit Bharat 2047
description: The legislation aims to give micro, small and medium enterprises (MSMEs) a superior regulatory framework. With MSMEs playing a vital role in driving economic growth, a responsive and reliable ecosystem is crucial to their success.

title: China-plus-one opportunity: India didn’t miss the bus, but built a stop for the tech buses that matter
description: India has been putting in place the policies, digital infrastructure and human resources required to attract foreign investment in emerging fields of technology. This efforts should pay off as global capital reaches for rewarding destinations.

title: As citizens of Independent India, we must fulfil our basic duties even as we guard fundamental rights
description: India’s 80th Independence Day is an occasion for both celebration and reflection. Let’s take a moment to reflect on why fundamental rights and responsibilities—as laid out by the Constitution—must always go hand-in-hand.

title: Mint Quick Edit | Lessons from Partition: here’s what the country must never forget
description: India’s post-partition generations have a responsibility to ensure that the horrors of that 1947 rupture are neither forgotten nor repeated. They bear another onus too: to grasp what fosters national cohesion.
